## Orientation Day

`orientation` · *Easy · 2 patients · no surprises* · difficulty easy · shift 13:00–16:00 (180 min) · default time ×4 · layout `ed`

> Your first afternoon in the Grand Therapies Medical Center ED. Two patients, a supportive attending, and time to learn the workflow: history, exam, AgentChart orders, the phone, and disposition.

**Learning goals**

- Ottawa ankle rules and imaging stewardship
- Pregnancy testing before CT in women of reproductive age
- Consulting surgery with a tight presentation
- Using the EHR: orders, results, notes, disposition

## Night Shift

`night_shift` · *Medium · 4 patients · staff errors on* · difficulty medium · shift 22:00–03:00 (300 min) · default time ×6 · layout `ed`

> A Thursday night in the ED: a chest pain walks in, EMS brings a confused grandmother, a palpitations patient with a very similar name arrives, and the ankle in Fast Track is getting impatient. The nurses are stretched — and not every error will be yours.

**Learning goals**

- STEMI recognition and door-to-activation times
- RV infarction and nitrate contraindications
- Sepsis hour-1 bundle and antibiotic selection from prior cultures
- Collateral history (family, GP after-hours line)
- AF rate control, precipitants and stroke prevention
- Catching staff errors: incomplete vitals, cultures after antibiotics, look-alike names

### Staff errors to catch

| Error | Patient | What happens | Credit for | Pts | Teaching |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `err_temp`<br>missing_triage_vital | Margarethe Brunner (Bed 4) | Triage vitals are recorded without a temperature at arrival. | Noticed the missing triage temperature (Bed 4) and had it measured | 8 | A missing temperature hides a SIRS/sepsis criterion — always check triage vitals for completeness. |
| `err_cultures`<br>abx_before_cultures | Margarethe Brunner (Bed 4) | When an antibiotic is about to be hung before blood cultures are drawn, the nurse announces it and gives it unless told to draw cultures first. | Prevented antibiotics from hanging before blood cultures (Bed 4) | 8 | Draw blood cultures before antibiotics — but never delay antibiotics > 45 min to get them. |
| `err_wrong_pt`<br>wrong_patient_med | Robert Keller (Bed 2), meant for Robert Kellner (Bed 3) | At 22:52 (+52 min) Tom Becker brings metoprolol 5 mg IV push over 2 min (Dr. Shaw (verbal, for Kellner)) to the wrong patient; 6 min to stop it. | Stopped metoprolol meant for Kellner (Bed 3) from being given to Keller (Bed 2) | 15 | Look-alike names: use two identifiers (name + DOB/MRN) and check the order against the wristband before every administration. |
